In short: [b]more joy in picking cards, and a deeper ninja experience[/b].[/p][p]Thanks for playing—your feedback keeps us honing the blade![/p]

notes.title: Update to Demo Version 25.08
notes.notes:
[p]🔷 Ver.25.08 Update Notes[/p][p]■ Enhanced UI & Feedback Flow
This update focuses on polishing the user interface for a smoother gameplay experience. Several key improvements have been implemented to make visual feedback clearer and actions more intuitive—especially during fast-paced combat.[/p][p]■ Asynchronous Processing for Snappier Play
Core systems have been restructured to utilize asynchronous control flows. This ensures a more seamless transition between animations, effects, and input handling, leading to a tighter and more responsive feel overall.[/p][p]Please note that some minor issues may still arise due to the ongoing transition to this asynchronous model. While none are expected to significantly hinder gameplay, we’d appreciate your feedback if you encounter any problems 🙌[/p]

notes.title: Update to Demo Version 25.07
notes.notes:
[h3]🔷 Ver.25.07 Update Notes[/h3][p][b]■ Core Combat System: Spirit & Seal[/b]
This update introduces two key mechanics to define Suzaku’s combat style:
[b]Spirit[/b], a resource consumed to perform powerful actions, and
[b]Seal[/b], a scalable element that enhances abilities over time.
These systems bring deeper strategic layers to each battle.[/p][p][b]■ Refreshed Starting Deck[/b]
The starting deck has been rebuilt into a new 10-card set.
In addition to the classic Strike and Guard actions, it now includes two cards centered on Spirit and Seal, allowing players to experience the game’s core mechanics from the very first turn.[/p][p][b]■ Expanded Event System on the Map[/b]
The map now features a greater number of events.
Unlike regular battles, events offer unique boons and narrative encounters—encouraging players to explore varied routes and shaping each run with meaningful choices.[/p]

notes.title: Update to Demo Version 25.06-D
notes.notes:
[p][b]Paths Diverge, Choices Deepen — Ver25.06-D Now Live![/b][/p][p]This update brings richer encounters and sharper balance across your journey.[/p][p]🌀 [b]More Events, More Stories[/b]
Seven unique events now await you, each offering distinct rewards — or dilemmas. Your decisions matter more than ever.[/p][p]⚖️ [b]Card & Enemy Rebalancing[/b]
Dozens of tweaks have been made to keep every draw and every fight meaningful.
Expect new synergies — and new threats.[/p][p]Every path is now more unpredictable.
Every battle, more deliberate.
How will you walk the NINDO?[/p]

notes.title: Update to Demo Version 25.06-C
notes.notes:
[p][b]Power Within, Precision Required — Ver25.06-C Now Live![/b][/p][p]This update redefines the rhythm of combat with an all-new resource system and heightened enemy strength.[/p][p][b]Enhanced Foe Behavior[/b]
Enemies hit harder and act smarter. Stay sharp — brute force won’t be enough.[/p][p][b]New Spirit & Seal System[/b]
Balance risk and reward with [b]Spirit[/b], a power that builds and bursts.
Master the flow of [b]Seals[/b] — each one adds strength, and unleashing them brings overwhelming effects.[/p][p]Think ahead. Build power. Release it at the perfect moment.
Victory now favors those who plan — and adapt.[/p]

notes.title: Update to Demo Version 25.06-B
notes.notes:
[p][b]Sharper Foes, Smarter Play — Ver25.06-B Now Live![/b][/p][p]This update brings key enhancements to the heart of battle, sharpening both challenge and clarity.[/p][p][b]Multi-Enemy Combat[/b]
You can now engage multiple enemies at once — plan your moves carefully against varied threats.[/p][p][b]Enemy Action Titles[/b]
Enemy intents now display named actions, helping you read the battlefield more intuitively.[/p][p][b]Refined Card Conditions[/b]
Playable cards now more accurately reflect their usage conditions with blue highlights, aligning visuals and rules.[/p][p]Test your tactics against stronger opposition — and look sharp while doing it.[/p]

notes.title: Update to Demo Version 25.06-A
notes.notes:
[p][b]Refined, Streamlined, and Battle-Ready — Ver25.06-A Now Live![/b][/p][p]Following the debut of our procedural map system in Ver25.06, we've made important refinements based on your feedback.[/p][list][*][p][b]Compact Map Design[/b]

notes.title: Update to Demo Version 25.06
notes.notes:
[p][b]Experience the New Strategic Map System — Now Live in the Demo![/b][/p][p]NINDO’s demo has evolved.
At the heart of this update lies a powerful new [b]procedural map generation system[/b] inspired by the best of roguelike design.[/p][list][*][p]Each run presents [b]branching paths[/b] with meaningful choices.[/p][/*][*][p]Routes are dynamically generated with [b]treasures, rest spots, shops, and elite battles[/b] carefully balanced to encourage different playstyles.[/p][/*][*][p]Our custom rule engine ensures a [b]fair but unpredictable map layout[/b], designed for replayability and strategic planning.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ve built this system from the ground up to offer [b]fresh, meaningful decisions in every run[/b].
Give it a try—and discover the path that suits your shinobi soul.[/p]

notes.title: Update to Demo Version 25.05-B
notes.notes:
[p]To further enhance the strategic depth of NINDO, we’ve implemented several long-awaited features and adjustments:[/p][p][b]Card Upgrade System[/b]
You can now upgrade your cards to more powerful versions. Strengthen your deck and sharpen your strategy.[/p][p][b]Card Removal System[/b]
Unwanted cards can now be removed from your deck. This allows for tighter and more optimized builds.[/p][p][b]Enemy Behavior Tweaks[/b]

notes.title: Update to Demo Version 25.05-A
notes.notes:
To further refine the gameplay experience in Ver.25.05-A, we’ve introduced several key improvements:

Enhanced Defeat Conditions
If the player’s health drops to zero during their own turn due to status effects like Poison or Burn, a defeat sequence will now trigger properly.

New Reward Screen Features

You can now cancel and exit the card reward screen after opening it.

Card interactions on the reward screen have been polished for a smoother experience.

A new option has been added to allow players to skip battle rewards entirely.

These improvements aim to provide a smoother and more flexible gameplay experience.
We hope you enjoy the ongoing evolution of NINDO and look forward to bringing you even more updates!

notes.title: Update to Demo Version 25.05
notes.notes:
To support the expanded gameplay volume in Ver.25.05, we’ve made a wide range of updates and refinements:

Major Combat System Overhaul
We’ve introduced new features including deck and discard pile viewers, as well as enhanced tooltip functionality. These changes make it easier to strategize during battles.

Revamped Map Generation System
The map is now procedurally generated, giving each run a unique progression experience filled with unpredictable paths and encounters.

Visual Enhancements
Card frames and map node icons have been redesigned to better match the world and improve readability.

Compared to Ver.25.04, this update focuses on making the game more replayable and enjoyable with each session.
We hope you enjoy the evolving NINDO experience and look forward to more updates ahead!

notes.title: 🌕 NINDO DAY - May Update: More Chaos, More Ninja!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
This is Morikichi, developer of NINDO - Guardian of the Starlit Shadow.

For this month’s NINDO DAY (May 20), I’m excited to share our upcoming update:

📦 Version 25.05 - Coming May 28!
This new build will expand the demo’s volume while deepening the replayability.
Though compact in scale, our goal is to deliver a different experience every time you play.

Here’s what’s coming:

🗺️ Randomized Maps
Each run will generate a new path, offering unique routes and challenges every time.

⚔️ New Enemy Encounters
Fresh enemy types will be added to spice up the battles and keep you on your toes.

🎴 New Events
Immerse yourself deeper into the world of NINDO with flavorful events that blend growth and storytelling.

🎨 Visual Enhancements
We’re introducing original map icons, redesigned card frames, and UI polish to elevate the overall visual quality.

🛠️ Looking Ahead to 25.06
Next, we’ll focus on optimizing performance and enriching visual assets to strengthen both design and feel.
A smoother experience awaits!

🌌 The shadows shift—but the path continues.
Thank you for walking this journey with us.
Let’s meet again on May 28!

notes.title: Update to Demo Version 25.04-D
notes.notes:
To support the upcoming expansion in game volume planned for Ver.25.05, the following foundational system updates have been implemented:

Map Progression Simplified
The map progression has been streamlined into a single-layer format to improve clarity and flow.

Expanded Tooltip Coverage
In-game tooltips now appear on more UI elements, making it easier to understand key information at a glance.

Improved Card Interaction
Card handling has been refined. Cards that target the player can now be used by dragging them slightly upward from your hand.

notes.title: Update to Demo Version 25.04-C
notes.notes:
The May 2025 update, Ver.25.04-C, introduces several improvements and additions to the demo version of NINDO - Guardian of the Starlit Shadow -.

🔄 Key Changes
Major Balance Adjustments
Various parameters related to cards, enemies, and equipment have been significantly revised to enhance strategic gameplay.

New Enemy Behavior Patterns
Certain enemy characters now feature new action patterns, adding more depth and unpredictability to battles.

4 New Cards Added
Four new cards have been introduced, including Martial, Ninjutsu, and Tactics types, enabling fresh strategies and playstyles.

Please feel free to share your gameplay and feedback through streams or reviews — just remember to follow our guidelines!

notes.title: Update to Demo Version 25.04-B

notes.title: Update to Demo Version 25.04-A
notes.notes:
Overview:
We have implemented bug fixes and feature improvements based on issues found in Ver25.04 and player feedback from reviews.

Details:

Fixed an issue where ending the turn while drawing multiple cards would cause the drawing process to resume in the next turn.

Fixed an issue where card reward displays at the end of battle were affected by in-battle status modifiers.

Fixed an issue where "Victory" was incorrectly displayed upon a game over when the player's HP reached zero.

Added tooltip descriptions to status effect icons.

Adjusted the display position of equipment tooltips for better visibility.

Thank you for your continued support and we hope you look forward to future updates!

notes.title: NINDO DAY - April Update: Demo Launch Incoming!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
I’m Morikichi, a solo indie game developer working on NINDO - Guardian of the Starlit Shadow.
This month’s NINDO DAY (April 20) comes with some exciting news!

🕹️ Demo Launch: April 25 (Fri)
We're releasing the first playable demo of NINDO on April 25!

This demo is a prototype build that offers a small but complete loop of the core gameplay we’re aiming for:
a deckbuilding roguelite experience, infused with ninja action and strategy.

Playable Character: SUZU

Stage: Mini-ACT with 2 areas + a boss battle

Cards: Around 20, including Martial, Ninjutsu, and Tactics types

🔥 It’s your first step into the world of NINDO.
Give it a try and let us know what you think!

🗼 Exhibition: Tokyo Game Dungeon 8 - May 4 (Sun)
We're excited to exhibit NINDO at Tokyo Game Dungeon 8,
an indie game showcase happening in Tokyo on May 4 (Sun).

I'll be attending in person, so if you're planning to visit the event, feel free to stop by and say hi!

🧭 Featured on Steam: April 26 – May 11
NINDO will also be featured on Steam’s special Tokyo Game Dungeon 8 page
from April 26 to May 11.

You’ll find us directly from the Steam homepage during this period—
a great chance to spread the word and gather feedback.

🌠 Closing Words
"The path of the shinobi, guided by the starlit shadow."
This demo marks the beginning of that journey.

Thank you for your support—and I hope you enjoy what’s ahead.
